Usage: mcp-browser-agent [options] [command]

MCP server giving AI agents structured perception of web pages

Options:
  -V, --version                    output the version number
  -h, --help                       display help for command

Commands:
  connect <url>                    Connect to a running dev server or URL
  observe [options]                Observe the current page state
  locate [options] <query>         Find elements by semantic query (e.g.,
                                   role=button name~="Submit")
  lint [options]                   Run UI linters/detectors on the current page
  screenshot [options]             Capture screenshot(s) of the current page
  serve                            Start MCP server (stdio transport)
  act [options] <action> <target>  Execute an action on a page element
  help [command]                   display help for command
